summary: Concrete Pumping Holdings filed an 8-K reporting Q3 FY2026 results and announced initiation of a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.13 per share, payable October 2, 2026, to holders of record September 18, 2026. The Board also approved extension of the existing share repurchase plan. Revenue rose 13% to $116.8 million; adjusted EBITDA up 13% to $30.4 million. Full-year outlook raised. The dividend initiation and share repurchase extension signal a capital return program. Watch for continued execution and any incremental buyback activity.
